'''Urs von Gunten''' (born 20 October 1959) is a Swiss environmental chemist and a professor at [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne|EPFL (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne)]]. He is known for his research in the fields of drinking water quality and water treatment.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Urs von Gunten|url=https://people.epfl.ch/urs.vongunten/?lang=en|access-date=2020-09-09|website=people.epfl.ch}}</ref>

== Career ==
Urs von Gunten obtained a diploma in [[chemistry]] in 1983 and a PhD in [[inorganic chemistry]] in 1989 from [[ETH Zurich]]. He then performed post-doctoral work at the [[Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology|Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science]] (Eawag), where he became head of the chemistry department (1998–1999) and of the Water Resources and Drinking Water department (2000–2004). He then took the lead of the cross-disciplinary project 'Drinking Water for the 21st century' until 2008, was the head of the transdisciplinary project “Regional Water Supply Basel Country 21” (2013–2016) and of the competence center for drinking water (2010–2017) at [[Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology|Eawag]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=Staff - Eawag|url=https://www.eawag.ch/en/aboutus/portrait/organisation/staff/profile/urs-von-gunten/show/|access-date=2020-09-09|website=www.eawag.ch}}</ref>

Urs von Gunten was appointed lecturer at [[ETH Zurich]] in 1995 and an adjunct professor in 2006. He was a visiting scientist at the [[University of Colorado]] in [[Boulder, Colorado|Boulder]] (2000–2001), and a visiting professor at the [[Curtin University]] in [[Perth]], [[Australia]] (2008–2009) and at the [[University of California, Berkeley]] (2017–2018). In 2011, he was nominated full professor at [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne|EPFL (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne)]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last=mfs|date=2010-12-16|title=Urs von Gunten, new IIE professor|url=https://actu.epfl.ch/news/urs-von-gunten-new-iie-professor/|language=en}}</ref>

== Research ==
Urs von Gunten heads the laboratory for Water Quality and Treatment (LTQE) at [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne|EPFL]] and the drinking water chemistry group at [[Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology|Eawag]].<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web|title=LTQE|url=https://www.epfl.ch/labs/ltqe/|access-date=2020-09-09|website=www.epfl.ch|language=en-GB}}</ref> His research focuses on oxidation and disinfection processes in the context of drinking water and waste water treatments. He has notably extensively studied the formation of potentially toxic chemical byproducts upon drinking water ozonation and chlorination.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=von Gunten|first=Urs|date=2003-04-01|title=Ozonation of drinking water: Part I. == Distinctions ==
Urs von Gunten received the  Harvey Rosen Award in 2001, 2007 and 2015 from the International Ozone Association, as well as the Environmental Science and Technology Excellence in Review Award in 2007.<ref>{{Cite web|title=International Ozone Association - Harvey Rosen Award|url=https://ioa-pag.org/Harvey-Rosen-Award|access-date=2020-09-09|website=ioa-pag.org|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-05-29|title=Harvey M. Rosen Memorial Award für Lisa Salhi und Urs von Gunten|url=https://www.myscience.ch/en/news/wire/harvey_m_rosen_memorial_award_fuer_lisa_salhi_und_urs_von_gunten-2015-eawag|access-date=2020-09-09|website=www.myscience.ch|language=en}}</ref><ref name=":1" /> It is announced, that he will receive the ACS Award for Creative Advances in Environmental Science and Technology in 2022.<ref>{{Cite web|title=ACS 2022 national award winners|url=https://cen.acs.org/people/awards/ACS-2022-national-award-winners/99/i35|access-date=2021-09-30|website=cen.acs.org|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Prestigious award for Urs von Gunten|url=https://www.eawag.ch/en/news-agenda/news-portal/news-detail/prestigious-award-for-urs-von-gunten/}}</ref>

In 2007, he received an Honorary Professorship at the [[Harbin Institute of Technology]].<ref name=":1" /> He has been an adjunct professor at the [[Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology]] since 2012.<ref name=":1" /> In 2015, he received a professorship under the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] President's International Fellowship Initiative for Distinguished Scientists.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Overney|first=Jan|date=2015-09-04|title=Urs von Gunten awarded by the Chinese Academy of Sciences|url=https://actu.epfl.ch/news/urs-von-gunten-awarded-by-the-chinese-academy-of-s/|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Major Commendation for Urs von Gunten|url=https://www.eawag.ch/en/news-agenda/news-portal/news-archive/archive-detail/grosse-auszeichnung-fuer-urs-von-gunten/|access-date=2021-01-14|website=www.eawag.ch|language=en-GB}}</ref>

As of 2021, his research papers have been cited more than 38,000 times and his [[h-index]] is 97.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Urs von Gunten - Google Scholar|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=svob4rcAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao|access-date=2020-09-09|website=scholar.google.com}}</ref> He was a highly cited researcher according to [[Thomson Reuters]] [[Web of Science]] in 2014 and 2015, and according to [[Clarivate|Clarivate Analytics]] in 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Tomaniak|first=Alina|date=2018-12-13|title="Highly Cited Researcher" at LTQE|url=https://actu.epfl.ch/news/highly-cited-researcher-at-ltqe-2/|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Tomaniak|first=Alina|date=2019-11-25|title=Prof. Urs von Gunten recognized as highly cited researcher 2019|url=https://actu.epfl.ch/news/prof-urs-von-gunten-recognized-as-highly-cited-res/|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Urs von Gunten's Publons profile|url=https://publons.com/researcher/1639065/urs-von-gunten/|access-date=2020-09-09|website=publons.com|language=en}}</ref>
